scheduler_signal.summary: The six-case constant-D/fixed-boundary study is closed. Its two registered current objectives were completed, and both dispositions are inconclusive: recovered evidence covers all 13 required artifacts and normalized-shape convergence passed, but own-anchor WRMSE was 2.2445359 and 2.0127536 decade, above the 0.15-decade adequacy gate, while M0-M2/S0-S2 tail sensitivity crossed low, intermediate, and high categories. G=-0.01408761 remains descriptive and cannot trigger rejection. The immutable external execution remains failed/97 because declared *.tdr paths differed from actual *_fps.tdr paths; recovery does not rewrite that state. The portfolio schema requires nonempty current_objectives, cases, validation_plans, and priority_order, so the completed proposal is retained as a documentary stage-close record rather than an executable next study. Overall mechanism separation remains open and needs separately qualified inputs for one finite profile-shape-changing counterfactual; stronger tail claims separately need qualified raw SIMS rows.

payload.objective: Use the supplied paper evidence to support later selection of falsifiable hypotheses and design of a minimal TCAD control experiment, while this Intake is limited to evidence extraction and does not select a hypothesis.
payload.priority_rationale: The sole proposal remains in priority_order because the ExperimentPortfolio schema requires a nonempty order and proposal set. It is a closed historical record, not authorization or a request for another execution. Both selected current objectives were completed: all 13 required artifacts are now covered and normalized-shape convergence passed, but the frozen family failed its 0.15-decade own-anchor adequacy gate with WRMSE 2.2445359 and 2.0127536 decade, and the registered tail comparison changed category across M0-M2/S0-S2. Both hypothesis dispositions therefore remain inconclusive, and the observed G=-0.01408761 is descriptive only. Repeating the same six cases, changing only boundary amplitudes, or adding another numerical tier cannot identify the missing profile-shape physics and has low incremental information value. The original later branch required an adequate base family and stable direct-pixel above-limit tail contrast; neither condition was met. Overall mechanism separation is retained as a later objective but is not expanded into current cases. Its next design must wait for a separately qualified finite model family that defines one shape-changing structural intervention, bounded variables, equations or parameters, boundary conditions, outputs, and a decision rule, followed by backend feasibility and matching reviews. A stronger tail conclusion separately requires qualified author raw SIMS rows with consistent detection status and independent uncertainty. No new model, parameter, mechanism fact, or executable case is invented in this revision.

value_assessment.rationale: The completed current objectives covered both mandatory observables within their qualified-subset bounds: material-resolved M0 profile error tested the surface-anchor comparison, while contiguous no-gap T and M0-M2/S0-S2 sensitivity tested the front/tail contrast. Recovery now covers all 13 required artifacts, so evidence support for the bounded outcome is high. The numerical convergence gate passed, but own-anchor WRMSE values of 2.2445359 and 2.0127536 decade exceeded 0.15 decade; consequently G=-0.01408761 cannot support or falsify surface-boundary control. Tail response crossed low, intermediate, and high registered categories, so it also remains inconclusive. These results complete the two current objectives without closing the overall mechanism-separation objective. The original six cases were minimal for the 2x2 boundary comparison plus two normalized-shape convergence controls, and their settings, identities, predictions, and validation gates are preserved as history. Their current discrimination power and incremental information gain are low because another boundary-amplitude run or numerical tier cannot repair the frozen constant-D/fixed-boundary family's shape inadequacy. The original later microscopic branch is deferred because its adequate-family and stable-tail preconditions both failed. A new current study may be selected only after qualified evidence defines one finite profile-shape-changing structural model and its implementation operands, boundary conditions, outputs, uncertainty treatment, and decision rule. Stronger tail claims separately require qualified author raw SIMS rows. These later conditions do not invalidate the completed experiment and are not current authoring or execution prerequisites.
